name: Nifty 50 EMA Lab

current.note: Intraday rule: flat at the session's last candle; next session opens on the side its first candle closes.

limits: Backtests use the same history that picked the winner (in-sample). Expect live results to be weaker.
Costs: 1.5 Nifty points per round trip. Real slippage on fast moves can be larger.
15-minute and 30-minute history is about 60 sessions (Yahoo limit); hourly ~2 years; daily 10 years. The page keeps every new bar, so intraday history grows each day.
Index candles, not futures: futures add a basis and gaps that the index does not show.
A trend-following EMA rule loses in sideways markets; it is a direction filter, not a guarantee.
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.
